newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends weaker, pulled lower by U.S.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends weaker, pulled lower by U.S.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed weaker on Wednesday, pulled down by weakness in NYMEX crude which coloured the whole energy complex.
The February contract closed down 75 cents at $203.25 a tonne having achieved an intra day high of $207.25 around mid-morning.

"The U.S lost it and pulled everything down with it," said one IPE floor trader. NYMEX selling was mainly technically-led and a recovery was anticipated by dealers as sellers secured their profits and covered their shorts.
Strong end of close selling also contributed bearish pressure, limiting gas oil's room to manoeuvre to a healthy end.
Attention remained focused on the American Petroleum Institute (API) stock data, which is due to be released later on Wednesday.
The March Brent/gas oil spread closed at $4.32.

March Brent was trading 10 cents up at $22.46 a barrel at 1800 GMT, having climbed back from a low of $22.31 that was triggered by the WTI weakness. With some gains still expected in Brent, gas oil may be playing catch-up on Thursday's open, dealers said.
